# oBizee

Last updated: 2026-03-03
Website: https://obizee.com
Contact: admin@obizee.com

## One-line positioning
oBizee is the order of business for Indian sellers: an India-first SaaS platform to manage orders, inventory, payments, shipping, and customer communication from one place.

## Who it is for
- Small businesses in India
- Instagram and WhatsApp sellers
- Early-stage D2C brands
- Home businesses and solo founders

## What oBizee does
- Builds your online storefront with ready templates
- Tracks orders from enquiry to delivery
- Manages inventory and stock alerts
- Supports payment tracking and invoicing
- Gives sales and growth analytics
- Helps teams run operations from mobile and web dashboards
